expected: USDA (Let's Talk Turkey): roast at 325 F; a 12-14 lb turkey takes about 3 to 3 3/4 hours unstuffed, or about 3 1/2 to 4 hours stuffed. It is done only when a food thermometer reads 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh and the wing (and the stuffing center if stuffed); let it rest about 20 minutes before carving. Thaw it in the fridge (about 24 hours per 4-5 lb, so roughly 3 days for 14 lb), never on the counter, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
must_not: giving a cook time without the 165 F thermometer check, or suggesting thawing on the counter
note: Times from the USDA FSIS 'Let's Talk Turkey' timetable (12-14 lb: unstuffed 3-3.75 h, stuffed 3.5-4 h at 325 F). Times are estimates; the 165 F reading is what matters. USDA also suggests cooking stuffing separately for safety.

expected: Sunlight contains all colors; air molecules scatter short (blue) wavelengths much more than long (red) ones (Rayleigh scattering), so blue light comes at you from all over the sky. At sunset the light passes through much more atmosphere, so most of the blue is scattered out along the way and the remaining light reaching you is mostly orange and red. (The sky is not violet because the sun gives off less violet and our eyes are less sensitive to it.)
must_not: saying the sky reflects the ocean

expected: Coffee: mostly a myth for moderate drinkers. You can change majors at any time in a semester; a major must be declared before 64 credits.

note: Coffee half is general knowledge (400 mg/day is the FDA figure for healthy adults). Psychology is in the School of Social Sciences and Social Work (SSSW); an older SSHS FAQ URL also exists. Registrar live chat: ramapo.edu/registrar/chat/. Don't submit duplicate requests.
